thread.title: Apple alters Japan iPhone contracts after antitrust warning - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Apple alters Japan iPhone contracts after antitrust warning - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) has changed its iPhone sales contracts in Japan after regulators said the tech giant could be violating antitrust rules.
Japan’s Fair Trade Commission accuses Apple of forcing the three largest local mobile service providers to offer subsidies in order to sell iPhones at a discount.
The FTC says the subsidies restrict competition since the carriers can’t offer lower or varied monthly plans to consumers.
Regulators began investigating Apple in late 2016 but completed the probe without punishment after Apple agreed to revise the contracts.
SoftBank ( OTCPK:SFTBF , OTCPK:SFTBY ) signed an exclusive deal a decade ago to sell iPhones in Japan. Subsidies helped grow sales since Japanese consumers could buy handsets for a lower initial cost. Carriers could then charge more in monthly fees. Japan has become Apple’s second-largest Asian market after China.
Apple shares are down 0.7% premarket to $188.94.
